Body.Content:
The November 2026 non-security preview update is now available for Windows 11, versions 26H2, 26H1, and 25H2. Information about the contents of this update is available in the release notes, which are accessible from the Windows 11 update history page. To learn more about the different types of monthly quality updates, see Understanding Windows monthly updates.
 
Highlights for the Windows 11, version 26H2 update:
  • Windows Search has a streamlined design with a single results list, file previews, and inline actions that let you change settings or arrange windows directly from search.
  • Windows Hello facial recognition can now temporarily brighten your screen to help you sign in when you're in a dark or dimly lit room.
  • Search from This PC in File Explorer is now indexer-based, making it much faster and consistent with search from File Explorer Home.
  • Gaming Task View in XBOX mode adds access to the full set of taskbar Quick settings without leaving XBOX mode.
  • A new Pointer indicator makes it easier to locate and use the mouse pointer.
  • The Run dialog has a more modern design and improved usability, available by turning on New Run dialog in Settings > System > Advanced.
 
For instructions on how to install this update, see the KB article for your operating system listed below:
  • Windows 11, versions 26H2 and 25H2: KB5132057
  • Windows 11, version 26H1: KB5132265
 
IMPORTANT: Because of minimal operations during the Western holidays and the upcoming new year, there will be no December 2026 non-security preview update in the second part of the month. Normal monthly servicing for both security and non-security preview updates will resume in January 2027.

Note: With recent and upcoming Windows updates over the next few months, a limited number of consumer and business devices might experience one additional restart during installation. This one‑time restart occurs after a Secure Boot certificate update is applied as part of the Secure Boot update process.

Title: The November 2026 Windows non-security preview update is now available
